Uses and Administration Sodium perborate is a mild disinfectant and deodorant. It readily releases oxygen in contact with oxidisable matter and has been used in aqueous solutions for purposes similar to weak solutions of hydrogen peroxide. Sodium perborate is used for tooth whitening and has also been used, with calcium carbonate, as a toothpowder. A freshly pre- pared solution is used as a mouthwash. The monohydrate is used similarly.
